title: OpenAI Bought NextSlide to Make AI Presentations Good
kw_reason: The short opens on the problem (AI sucks at creating presentations) and closes on the hope that we finally get presentations that are both pretty and understandable. 'Pretty' is the payoff word the whole acquisition story builds toward, and at 6 characters it can carry the terracotta line at full size.
hl_reason: AI SLIDES / COULD GET / PRETTY reads as one sentence that states the hope of the video: AI-made presentations may finally look good. The acquisition itself (OpenAI buying NextSlide) lives in the title, so the cover carries the viewer benefit with a short, dominant highlight.
claim: OpenAI acquired NextSlide, an app built so any AI model can create clear presentations, and its team now works on ChatGPT, so AI presentations that are both pretty and understandable might finally arrive.
quotes: AI sucks at creating presentations, but that might be changing soon enough.
OpenAI just acquired NextSlide, an application that was built exactly for this.
I really hope that for once we get presentations that are actually both pretty and also understandable.
reason: An acquisition announcement: OpenAI bought NextSlide and its team will work on ChatGPT. Miguel adds one opinion (AI presentations are bad today, he hopes they get pretty and understandable), but there is no repeatable procedure, so a concise news description carries everything useful.
yd:
OpenAI just acquired NextSlide, an app built so any AI model can create presentations that communicate things clearly. The NextSlide team will now work with OpenAI on the development of ChatGPT.

Why it matters: AI still sucks at making presentations. I really hope that for once we get slides that are both pretty and understandable.
